title: See You Again (feat. Charlie Puth)
rawTtml:
It's been a long day without you, my friend没有你的日子真漫长啊 我的老友

And I'll tell you all about it when I see you again我会在重逢之时与你倾诉这一切

When I see you again当我们重逢之时

Damn, who knew?谁能了解

All the planes we flew, good things we been through我们这一路来所经历的世事沧桑与幸福快乐

That I'd be standing right here talking to you无论何时 我总在你身边陪伴与你谈笑风生

'Bout another path, I know we loved to hit the road and laugh我们都坚定不移的走上这旅途 旅途中常有笑声陪伴

But something told me that it wouldn't last但这快乐的时光不会延绵不断

Had to switch up, look at things different, see the bigger picture我们必须抬起头 仰望未来

Those were the days, hard work forever pays那是一段艰苦的日子 但有心人终不负

Now I see you in a better place如今你的生活变得更好了

Uh, how can we not talk about family when family's all that we got?家庭是我们的一切 而我们又如何能忘却亲情？

Everything I went through, you were standing there by my side每当我遇到困难 你总在我身旁

And now you gon' be with me for the last ride而你如今将伴我走上这最后一程

It's been a long day without you, my friend好久不见 我的老友

And I'll tell you all about it when I see you again(I'll see you again)你我必将重逢当我们再次相会 我会告诉你关于这路上的一切

We've come a long way from where we began(Yeah, we came a long way)我们携手走过漫长的旅程我们携手走过漫长的旅程 从我们最初的起点

Oh, I'll tell you all about it when I see you again(You know we started, let me tell you)你知道我们已启程 我会倾诉所有再见之时 我会敞开心扉倾诉所有

When I see you again我期待着与你重逢的日子

Oh, oh

Woo

First you both go out your way and the vibe is feeling strong你从一开始就独立打拼 你我的感情也愈发浓厚

And what's small turn to a friendship, a friendship turned to a bond渺小的世界见证这段深情厚谊 友情蜕成血浓于水的感情

And that bond will never be broken, the love will never get lost(And the love will never get lost)此爱难逝此情不变 此爱难逝

And when brotherhood come first, then the line will never be crossed莫逆之交的我们 绝不会背叛彼此

Established it on our own, when that line had to be drawn只因这深情厚谊基于我们的真实情愿

And that line is what we reach, so remember me when I'm gone(Remember me when I'm gone)即便我离去 也请将我铭记这友谊让我们肝胆相照 荣辱与共 即便我离去 也请将我铭记

How can we not talk about family when family's all that we got?我们如何能忘却亲情 况且那是我们的全部？

Everything I went through, you were standing there by my side每次我堕入黑暗 你总是拉着我走向光明

And now you gon' be with me for the last ride而如今 你将与我共度最后一宵

So let the light guide your way, yeah让光指引着你向前的道路吧

Hold every memory as you go当你奔跑之时 不要忘记你的牵挂

And every road you take will always lead you home, home请坚信 你所走的每一步 都指引着你回家

It's been a long day without you, my friend没你的日子真是煎熬啊

And I'll tell you all about it when I see you again我会与你讲述我的思念如何连绵

We've come a long way from where we began我们历经沧海桑田

Oh, I'll tell you all about it when I see you again因此到达终点之时 我会与你共赏那轮明月 共品那杯美酒

When I see you again当我们重逢之时

See you again与你重逢
